newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Keppel Engineering starts China plants.
newsitem.headline: Keppel Engineering starts China plants.

text.p: Keppel Integrated Engineering Ltd said in a statement on Monday its steam plant and industrial gases plant in the Singapore Suzhou Industrial Park, China, have started operations.

The steam plant, with a present capacity of producing 40 tonnes of steam per hour, is now supplying steam to its first three customers. They are beverage maker Pokka, Lilly Healthcare and Hitachi Semiconductor.
The statement said the plant's total capacity could be increased to 100 tonnes per hour by adding two 30 tonnes per hour boilers.
"This will be done when there is such a demand justification," Keppel said.
The plant along with a 6.7 kiliometre steam reticulation requires a investment of US$9 million, it said.
Keppel added its air separation plant has begun supplying high purity pipeline products and services to customers in the Suzhou industrial park.
